headline: Nscale S-1 reports 461,000 active and contracted GPUs and $103.4B in active and contracted TCV
summary: Nscale's September 18, 2026 SEC registration statement reports that as of August 31 it had approximately 25,000 active GPUs and 461,000 active and contracted GPUs, with $2.6 billion of active and $103.4 billion of active and contracted total contract value (TCV) under long-term take-or-pay customer contracts. The filing defines TCV as revenue contracted over the committed term of signed agreements, excluding optional extensions, renewals and unexercised capacity. These figures provide an issuer-reported denominator for contracted AI infrastructure scale, but they do not establish that contracted GPUs are installed or delivered, or that the stated contract value will be recognized as revenue or collected.
